title: IndiGo flight with 224 onboard makes emergency landing after engine failure
content: On Tuesday night, an IndiGo flight traveling from Kolkata to Chennai encountered a left-engine failure, prompting the pilot to declare a full emergency before landing. Emergency protocols were enacted to facilitate the plane's safe arrival with 224 passengers aboard, ultimately resulting in a secure landing on Runway 25. Post-landing, airport operations returned to normal immediately.

title: 'I would be very worried': Ex-Sri Lankan cricketer names India's biggest weapon

Maharoof also highlighted Rishabh Pant as a significant threat to the Sri Lankan team.  Pant's ability to change games quickly worries the former player immensely.  Sri Lanka expects to counter Pant with significant spin bowling options.

title: 'Raped, whipped with belt': Nagpur girl held under 'digital arrest' for 3 mths before assault

The girl was held hostage, raped, and inflicted with multiple knife wounds.  Police rescued her after her parents filed a missing person complaint.  Investigators traced assault items to local pet shops.

title: Mamdani's regulation that 'angered' Amazon may impose an extra $664 per year fee

Critics argue the direct-hire mandate will eliminate small businesses and raise consumer prices. Separately, Mamdani issued notices to retailers over illegal e-bike sales. The city aims to enhance public safety by addressing dangerous devices.

title: Tata group stocks fall up to 4% as N Chandrasekaran steps down as chairman
content: Chandrasekaran's resignation marks an unexpected end to a tenure of nearly 10 years during which he reshaped India's largest business group, expanding its presence across sectors including airlines, semiconductors, electronics, batteries and digital businesses.

title: 2 killed, 2 injured after landslide hits Mumbai’s Kurla; several feared trapped
content: A devastating landslide hit Gaushiya Chawl in Kurla, Mumbai, on Wednesday morning, prompting immediate emergency response efforts. Fire brigade and police teams have arrived at the scene to assist with the rescue operations. There are concerns for the safety of numerous individuals believed to be trapped beneath the rubble. Authorities are eagerly awaiting updates to assess the full scale of the disaster.

title: Accenture CEO Julie Sweet makes an 'August request' to employees
content: Accenture has implemented a new policy allowing employees to carry over their unused vacation days, aiming to bolster business performance as the fiscal year winds down. CEO Julie Sweet has urged employees to maximize their efforts in these critical weeks. However, this adjustment may inadvertently dissuade workers from taking necessary breaks, raising concerns among investors following a decline in new bookings.

title: Russia appoints former CJI DY Chandrachud as arbitrator in Ukraine's Oschadbank case
content: Former Chief Justice of India D.Y. Chandrachud will serve as Russia's arbitrator in a dispute. This arbitration concerns Ukrainian bank Oschadbank's claims regarding lost assets in four regions. The dispute arises from Russian military actions and follows an earlier Crimea-related arbitration. Justice Chandrachud previously declined similar appointments from Russia. A three-member tribunal will now hear this significant investment treaty case.

title: TSMC builds 0.42nm interface to improve next-gen MoS2 transistors
content: Researchers from National Yang Ming Chiao Tung University and TSMC have developed a new interface design for atomically thin transistors. They created a 0.42-nanometre aluminium oxide layer between monolayer MoS2 and a hafnium oxide dielectric. The design helped the transistors maintain strong electrical control and carrier transport while using an extremely thin insulating layer.

title: Google founder donates $20mn more to organisation advocating against wealth tax

Opponents of the tax, which will be voted on in November, are far better funded than its supporters. Other prominent tech leaders have also joined in to support the campaign against the tax, showcasing a united front against the legislation.

title: Why US is questioning Pakistan's Rs 3 trillion defence spending

Concerns were also raised regarding government debt disclosure and budget proposal publication delays.  Pakistan's defence allocation has significantly increased for the upcoming financial year.  The report urges greater transparency in military and intelligence budgets.  This assessment highlights ongoing fiscal transparency challenges for Pakistan.

title: 'Rare for a kid to say, 'I want to be an athlete': What India needs for a squash boom

But India's star squash player Veer Chotrani believes sustained success requires more than courts and funding. India needs stronger coaching, training partners and a professional ecosystem at home, while families must increasingly view sport as a viable career alongside education.

title: Passenger ferry catches fire near Bali; 106 rescued, 25 still trapped
